PATTERN: When planning changes to the memory system, the three components that must be understood together are:
  1. Curator prompt — defines how memories are curated/distilled (prompt engineering layer)
  2. Store routing — controls how memories are written, scoped (global vs project), and indexed
  3. Checkpoint endpoint — orchestrates the full curation flow, called at session end
WHEN: Before any implementation work on the memory pipeline
WHY: These three components are tightly coupled — changing one without understanding the others leads to broken flows
